crossRefs.note: All of you stand today in the presence of Yahweh your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers…
I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an…
But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”
He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
Then they will be my people, and I will be their God.
For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t…
Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after…
For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, the days come”, says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the…
not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers, in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out…

parallels.note: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

translations.web: Yahweh didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.
translations.bsb: He did not make this covenant with our fathers, but with all of us who are alive here today.
translations.kjv: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.
translations.asv: Jehovah made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.
